title: The Open File Was the Point
setup: Your knight went to g4 and White took it, and both h-pawns left the h-file with your rook still sitting on h8.
hint: Your rook already stares down an open h-file at nothing at all — which piece can join it so that h2 cannot be held?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qh4}} gives no check, which is why it is hard to meet. Queen and rook now share the open h-file, White's knight has gone back to e1, and the bishop on b5 is on the wrong wing.

{{f4}}, making room for the king, is White's best try. {{g3}} answers it, and the mate cannot be stopped: even {{Qh5}}, blocking the file, only delays {{Qh1#}} by a move.

An open file beside a castled king is worth more than a knight.
